change_history.changes: Initial analysis based on code review findings - no actual issues exist in archived repository

note: Repository archived with no issues or pull requests. Analysis based on architectural review, identified gaps, and technical limitations.

key_insights.insight: Plugin Architecture Scalability: OSGi-compatible plugin system with 25+ plugins demonstrates extensible design but requires careful lifecycle management and dependency resolution. Plugin development complexity increases with scale.
action_items: Design plugin API with clear service interfaces and dependency injection
Implement plugin isolation to prevent conflicts
Create plugin templates and comprehensive development documentation
Separate portal (UI) plugins from logic (backend) plugins
Use Spring Boot for plugin lifecycle management
Provide hot-reload capabilities for development

key_insights.insight: Multi-User Collaboration Limitations: No explicit multi-tenancy support and limited model versioning constrain enterprise deployment. Group-based access control exists but lacks fine-grained permissions and data isolation.
action_items: Design multi-tenancy from the start with tenant isolation at database level
Implement comprehensive RBAC with fine-grained permissions
Add model versioning with full audit trail
Implement real-time collaboration features (WebSockets)
Add concurrent editing conflict resolution
Design for horizontal data sharding
Implement tenant-aware caching and session management

key_insights.insight: BPMN Editor Integration Complexity: JavaScript-based BPMN editor (Apromore-BPMN-Modeler-JS) integrated via portal plugin requires coordination between frontend build (Webpack) and backend deployment. Version synchronization and API contracts critical.
action_items: Separate frontend as standalone SPA with clear API boundaries
Use modern framework (React/Vue) instead of ZK Framework
Implement versioned REST APIs for editor-backend communication
Use WebSocket for real-time collaboration in editor
Implement client-side validation with BPMN 2.0 schema
Add comprehensive OpenAPI documentation
Design for offline editing with conflict resolution

key_insights.insight: Performance with Large Models: System has documented limits (5000 nodes, 15000 arcs) for process models. Graph visualization (Cytoscape) and animation become bottlenecks with complex models. Memory management and rendering optimization critical.
action_items: Implement virtual scrolling/viewport rendering for large graphs
Use WebGL-based rendering for complex visualizations (D3.js alternative)
Add progressive loading and lazy evaluation
Implement server-side graph simplification/aggregation
Use web workers for heavy computations
Implement efficient data structures (RoaringBitmap for sets)
Add performance monitoring and profiling tools
Design pagination for large model lists

key_insights.insight: Deployment and Installation Complexity: Manual MySQL configuration, complex Gradle multi-project setup, and dual storage model (DB + filesystem) increase deployment difficulty. No containerization out of the box limits cloud deployment.
action_items: Provide Docker containers with docker-compose for local development
Support multiple database backends (PostgreSQL, MySQL, H2)
Implement database auto-initialization with Liquibase
Create Kubernetes Helm charts for cloud deployment
Add health checks and readiness probes
Implement configuration externalization (environment variables, ConfigMaps)
Provide Infrastructure as Code templates (Terraform, CloudFormation)
Add comprehensive deployment documentation

key_insights.insight: Database and Persistence Challenges: Dual storage model (MySQL for metadata, filesystem for event logs) requires coordinated backup and transaction management. Liquibase migrations enable schema evolution but add complexity. No built-in multi-database sharding.
action_items: Design unified storage abstraction with pluggable backends
Support object storage (S3, Azure Blob) for event logs
Implement distributed transactions or saga pattern
Add automatic backup and restore functionality
Design for database sharding with tenant-based partitioning
Use PostgreSQL JSONB for flexible metadata storage
Implement read replicas for query scalability
Add connection pooling optimization (HikariCP tuning)

key_insights.insight: Monolithic Architecture Scalability: Spring Boot monolith with embedded Tomcat limits horizontal scalability and independent component deployment. Tight coupling between portal, manager, and plugins constrains evolution.
action_items: Decompose into microservices (API Gateway, Auth Service, Model Service, Mining Service, Storage Service)
Implement service mesh for inter-service communication (Istio, Linkerd)
Use message queue (Kafka, RabbitMQ) for asynchronous processing
Add API Gateway pattern for request routing
Implement CQRS for read/write separation
Use event-driven architecture for loose coupling
Add distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin)
Implement circuit breakers and bulkheads

key_insights.insight: License Restrictions Impact Reusability: LGPL 3.0 on core platform and key dependencies (ZK Framework, OpenXES, Hibernate, JBPT) requires derivative works to be LGPL. Incompatible with proprietary licensing, necessitating clean-room reimplementation.
action_items: Use only permissive licenses (Apache 2.0, MIT, BSD) for all dependencies
Audit all dependencies for license compatibility
Implement license scanning in CI/CD pipeline
Document licensing decisions and rationale
Consider commercial support licenses where needed
Avoid LGPL and GPL dependencies entirely for proprietary products

key_insights.insight: ZK Framework Vendor Lock-in: Java-based UI framework (LGPL 3.0) with ZUL markup creates vendor lock-in and limits frontend flexibility. Developers require ZK expertise, reducing talent pool. Modern frontend practices (React, Vue) not applicable.
action_items: Use modern JavaScript framework (React with TypeScript)
Implement headless backend with REST/GraphQL APIs
Separate frontend completely from backend deployment
Use Material-UI or Ant Design for component library
Implement server-side rendering (Next.js) for SEO
Add progressive web app capabilities
Use widely-adopted technologies to expand talent pool

key_insights.insight: Process Mining Algorithm Integration: SplitMiner uses complex Petri net and graph algorithms (JBPT, UMA, PNAPI). Integration of ProM framework provides extensive capabilities but adds complexity. Algorithm pluggability via strategy pattern enables flexibility.
action_items: Design algorithm abstraction layer with pluggable implementations
Use strategy pattern for algorithm selection
Implement async processing for long-running algorithms
Add progress reporting and cancellation
Cache algorithm results with intelligent invalidation
Provide algorithm comparison and benchmarking tools
Document algorithm parameters and tuning guidance
Consider cloud-based compute for resource-intensive algorithms

key_insights.insight: Event Log Processing at Scale: XES format handling via OpenXES with filesystem storage enables large file support (up to 500MB). APMLogModule provides advanced filtering and transformation. Memory management and streaming critical for large logs.
action_items: Implement streaming log processing to handle unlimited sizes
Use columnar storage (Parquet) for analytics optimization
Add incremental log import with resume capability
Implement log sampling and filtering at import time
Use time-series database for log storage (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB)
Add distributed processing (Apache Spark) for large-scale analytics
Implement log compression and archival
Add log quality validation and profiling

key_insights.insight: Visualization Performance Bottlenecks: Cytoscape-based graph rendering with SVG.js and Konva for animations creates performance challenges with complex models. Export to PDF (jsPDF) and image formats requires optimization.
action_items: Use Canvas/WebGL for large graph rendering instead of SVG
Implement level-of-detail rendering (LOD)
Add viewport-based culling for off-screen elements
Use web workers for layout calculations
Implement server-side rendering for static exports
Add interactive zoom levels with detail adaptation
Optimize animation frame rates and reduce repaints
Provide vector and raster export options

key_insights.insight: Security Implementation Gaps: SHA-256 password hashing with legacy MD5 support, 45-minute session timeout, and optional Keycloak SSO. No explicit API rate limiting, audit logging, or multi-tenancy data isolation.
action_items: Implement OAuth 2.0 / OIDC by default (no legacy auth)
Add comprehensive audit logging for all operations
Implement API rate limiting and throttling
Add RBAC with fine-grained permissions (resource-level)
Implement encryption at rest for sensitive data
Add security headers per OWASP recommendations
Implement SIEM integration for security monitoring
Add vulnerability scanning in CI/CD
Use secrets management (HashiCorp Vault)
Implement multi-tenancy with strict data isolation

key_insights.insight: Business Calendar Integration: Calendar management for working hours and holidays enables accurate duration calculations. Critical for process performance analysis but adds configuration complexity. Integration across components required.
action_items: Design flexible calendar abstraction (multiple calendars, time zones)
Support standard calendar formats (iCal)
Implement calendar inheritance and composition
Add holiday and working hours management UI
Support tenant-specific and user-specific calendars
Implement calendar-aware duration calculations
Add calendar validation and conflict detection
Document calendar configuration best practices

key_insights.insight: Model Repository and Versioning: Model storage in repository with sharing capabilities but no explicit version control. Database metadata with filesystem storage requires synchronization. Version history and change tracking missing.
action_items: Implement Git-like versioning for all models
Add branching and merging capabilities
Implement change history with diff visualization
Add rollback and restore functionality
Implement tagging and release management
Add change approval workflows
Implement model comparison and conflict resolution
Add comprehensive audit trail for all changes

key_insights.insight: API Design and Integration: REST APIs via Spring Jersey with SpringDoc OpenAPI documentation. No GraphQL support limits query flexibility. API versioning not prominently documented. Limited webhook and event notification capabilities.
action_items: Design RESTful APIs with proper resource modeling
Add GraphQL for flexible client queries
Implement comprehensive API versioning (URL or header-based)
Add webhook support for event notifications
Implement async APIs for long-running operations
Add pagination, filtering, sorting on all list endpoints
Implement HATEOAS for API discoverability
Add comprehensive OpenAPI 3.0 documentation
Implement API rate limiting per client
Add API analytics and usage monitoring

key_insights.insight: Testing and Quality Assurance: Testing infrastructure in place (JUnit, EasyMock, PowerMock, Karma, Jasmine) but coverage unknown. Code quality tools configured (Checkstyle, SpotBugs, JaCoCo, SonarQube). Integration testing approach unclear.
action_items: Aim for 80%+ code coverage with meaningful tests
Implement comprehensive integration testing
Add end-to-end testing (Cypress, Playwright)
Implement contract testing for APIs (Pact)
Add performance testing (JMeter, Gatling)
Implement mutation testing for test quality
Add smoke tests for deployments
Implement chaos engineering for resilience testing
Add security testing (OWASP ZAP)
Integrate quality gates in CI/CD

key_insights.insight: Configuration Management Complexity: Spring Boot application.properties with feature flags and profiles. Configuration scattered across multiple files. No externalized configuration management for distributed deployments.
action_items: Implement centralized configuration management (Spring Cloud Config, Consul)
Use feature flags service (LaunchDarkly, Unleash)
Externalize all configuration (12-factor app)
Support environment-specific configuration
Add configuration validation at startup
Implement hot reload for certain configurations
Add configuration versioning and rollback
Document all configuration parameters comprehensively
Implement secrets management separate from configuration

key_insights.insight: Observability and Monitoring Gaps: Limited observability infrastructure noted. No explicit metrics collection (Prometheus), distributed tracing (Jaeger), or centralized logging (ELK stack) mentioned in architecture.
action_items: Implement Prometheus metrics for all services
Add distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin)
Implement centralized logging (ELK, Loki)
Add application performance monitoring (APM)
Implement health checks and readiness probes
Add business metrics and KPIs
Implement alerting (PagerDuty, Opsgenie)
Create comprehensive dashboards (Grafana)
Add user behavior analytics
Implement error tracking (Sentry)

key_insights.insight: Data Export and Interoperability: CSV and Parquet export plugins. PDF export via jsPDF. BPMN XML import/export for standard compliance. Limited integration with external systems and data warehouses.
action_items: Support multiple export formats (CSV, JSON, Parquet, Avro)
Add scheduled export and ETL pipeline integration
Implement incremental export for large datasets
Add export templates and customization
Support direct data warehouse integration (Snowflake, BigQuery)
Implement streaming export for real-time analytics
Add import validation and error reporting
Support batch import with progress tracking
Implement data lineage tracking
Add data quality profiling on import/export

pain_points.description: Monolithic architecture limits horizontal scaling and independent component deployment
No explicit multi-tenancy support constrains enterprise SaaS deployment
Limited model versioning prevents comprehensive change tracking and rollback
Graph visualization bottlenecks with large models (5000+ nodes)
Manual setup, no containerization, complex multi-project build
ZK Framework vendor lock-in limits frontend flexibility and talent pool
LGPL 3.0 prevents code reuse in proprietary products
Limited API for external integrations, no GraphQL, unclear versioning
No real-time collaboration features for concurrent editing
Limited metrics, tracing, and centralized logging infrastructure
500MB upload limit and memory constraints for very large logs
No explicit API rate limiting, multi-tenancy isolation, or comprehensive audit logging

feature_requests.description: Decompose monolith into independently deployable microservices
Built-in multi-tenancy with data isolation and tenant management
Git-like versioning with branching, merging, and diff visualization
Add GraphQL alongside REST for flexible queries
WebSocket-based real-time editing and presence awareness
Prometheus metrics, distributed tracing, centralized logging
Docker containers and Helm charts for cloud-native deployment
OAuth 2.0, RBAC, API rate limiting, comprehensive audit logging
Kafka/RabbitMQ integration for streaming log processing
S3/Azure Blob support for event logs and models

architectural_decisions.rationale: Enables extensibility and modular functionality with 25+ specialized plugins
architectural_decisions.recommendation: Adopt plugin pattern but simplify with Spring Boot plugin system instead of full OSGi

architectural_decisions.rationale: Clear separation of concerns improves maintainability and testability
architectural_decisions.recommendation: Keep layered architecture but consider domain-driven design for better business logic organization

architectural_decisions.rationale: Optimizes storage: database for metadata/queries, filesystem for large binary event logs
architectural_decisions.recommendation: Use object storage (S3, Azure Blob) instead of filesystem for cloud-native deployment

architectural_decisions.rationale: Enables rapid Java-based UI development with MVVM pattern
architectural_decisions.recommendation: Replace with modern JavaScript framework (React + TypeScript) for better flexibility and ecosystem

architectural_decisions.rationale: Simplifies deployment with single application, embedded container
architectural_decisions.recommendation: Migrate to microservices for enterprise scale while keeping monolith for simple deployments

architectural_decisions.rationale: Provides rich graph manipulation and layout capabilities
architectural_decisions.recommendation: Consider Canvas/WebGL rendering (D3.js custom) for large graphs, keep Cytoscape for moderate sizes

architectural_decisions.rationale: Enables declarative schema evolution and versioning
architectural_decisions.recommendation: Keep Liquibase approach - industry best practice for database evolution

architectural_decisions.rationale: Standards compliance ensures interoperability with other process mining tools
architectural_decisions.recommendation: Support XES but also add modern formats (Parquet, JSON) and streaming protocols

architectural_decisions.rationale: Decouples UI from business logic for independent development
architectural_decisions.recommendation: Excellent pattern - maintain strict separation with well-defined APIs

architectural_decisions.rationale: Leverages established process mining algorithms and research
architectural_decisions.recommendation: Study ProM algorithms but implement clean-room versions with permissive licenses
